quotes.text:
bouncer-products-per-alias:
            by-release-type:
                beta:
                    thunderbird-beta-latest-ssl: installer-ssl
                    thunderbird-beta-latest: installer
                    thunderbird-beta-msi-latest-ssl: msi
                    thunderbird-beta-msix-latest-ssl: msix
                release:
                    thunderbird-latest-ssl: installer-ssl
                    thunderbird-latest: installer
                    thunderbird-msi-latest-ssl: msi
                    thunderbird-msix-latest-ssl: msix
                esr140:
                    # when there is one ESR branch both sets of aliases are set for that branch
                    # when there are two ESR branches ...
                    # ... these always point to the older branch
                    thunderbird-esr-latest-ssl: installer-ssl
                    thunderbird-esr-latest: installer
                    thunderbird-esr-msi-latest-ssl: msi
                    thunderbird-esr-msix-latest-ssl: msix
                esr153:
                    # ... these point to the newer branch
                    thunderbird-esr-next-latest-ssl: installer-ssl
                    thunderbird-esr-next-latest: installer
                    thunderbird-esr-next-msi-latest-ssl: msi
                    thunderbird-esr-next-msix-latest-ssl: msix
                default: {}

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 945 enables the monthly release branch of release-bouncer-aliases for installer, SSL installer, MSI and MSIX products. The accepted configuration selects aliases by release-type and retains separate beta, release and ESR families; ESR version numbers have advanced since 2024. Preserve the release-type distinction when updating release automation. This source configuration does not verify the external download service or actual shipped alias destinations.
title: Keep monthly release aliases distinct from ESR alias families
